lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 수리 기사입니다. 어디가 고장 났어요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm the repairman. What's broken?
lines.beaver_roman: Annyeonghaseyo. Suri gisaimnida. Eodiga gojang nasseoyo?
lines.learner: 어서 오세요. 부엌 수도꼭지가 고장 났어요.
lines.en: Come in. The kitchen faucet is broken.
lines.roman: Eoseo oseyo. Bueok sudokkokjiga gojang nasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What's wrong with it? Is it leaking?
lines.learner: 네, 잠을 못 잘 정도로 물이 뚝뚝 떨어져요.
lines.en: Yes, it drips so much I can't sleep.
lines.roman: Ne, jameul mot jjal jjeongdoro muri ttukttuk tteoreojyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: The rubber inside is worn out. I just need to replace it.
lines.learner: 다행이에요. 그리고 거실 조명도 좀 봐 주세요.
lines.en: That's a relief. Please also check the living room light.
lines.roman: Dahaengieyo. Geurigo geosil jomyeongdo jom bwa juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: The light itself is fine. What about the switch?
lines.learner: 스위치가 너무 뻑뻑해서 잘 안 눌러져요.
lines.en: The switch is so stiff it barely presses.
lines.roman: Seuwichiga neomu ppeokppeokaeseo jal an nulleojyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll need to replace the switch with a new one.
lines.learner: 주전자 손잡이도 부러졌어요. 고칠 수 있어요?
lines.en: The kettle handle broke too. Can you fix it?
lines.roman: Jujeonja sonjabido bureojyeosseoyo. Gochil ssu isseoyo?

lines.beaver: 손잡이는 고칠 수 있어요. 뚜껑은 괜찮아요?
lines.beaver_en: I can fix the handle. Is the lid okay?
lines.beaver_roman: Sonjabineun gochil ssu isseoyo. Ttukkeongeun gwaenchanayo?
lines.learner: 뚜껑은 괜찮아요. 살림이 다 낡아서 걱정이에요.
lines.en: The lid is fine. All my household things are old, so I'm worried.
lines.roman: Ttukkeongeun gwaenchanayo. Sallimi da nalgaseo geokjjeongieyo.

lines.beaver: 오래 쓰면 다 그래요. 다른 건 없어요?
lines.beaver_en: Everything gets like that with time. Anything else?
lines.beaver_roman: Orae sseumyeon da geuraeyo. Dareun geon eopseoyo?
lines.learner: 바가지랑 대접도 금이 갔어요. 그건 버릴게요.
lines.en: The basin and big bowl are cracked too. I'll throw those out.
lines.roman: Bagajirang daejeoptto geumi gasseoyo. Geugeon beorilkkeyo.

lines.beaver_en: The repair cost will be a bit high. Is that okay?
lines.learner: 수리비가 얼마나 나올까요? 너무 비싸면 곤란해요.
lines.en: How much will the repair cost be? It's a problem if it's too expensive.
lines.roman: Suribiga eolmana naolkkayo? Neomu bissamyeon gollanhaeyo.

lines.en: Cheaper than I thought. Housework was really inconvenient.

lines.beaver_en: Now you can use things comfortably. I'll start right away.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 저는 베개랑 담요 정리하고 있을게요.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll be tidying up the pillows and blankets.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida. Jeoneun begaerang damyo jeongnihago isseulkkeyo.
